coordinates.policy: Site display is Three.js Y-up. Rhino Map-Z-to-glTF-Y is already in the file; do not swap axes again. Plan polygons store (x,z) in site feet. Lattice proto forms stay 20×20×20 ft and are not stretched to the property.

originalBindings.note: Static conditional closure includes all source-envelope dispatch branches, not a claim that all branches execute. Runtime proof records the selected loaded modules separately.

siteRules.allocationMeaning: Area of permitted territory governed and organized by this typology, not a perimeter fraction or a claim of achieved footprint coverage

limitations: Controlled site proof; validation applies to the saved polygon, field and parameters only.
Explicit rectangular Rule A sampling only; irregular fields are rejected, never replaced with a fitted rectangle.
Six 8-ft letters / three levels / 15-ft spacing / 60-ft envelope validated. Other combinations deferred.
Native component overlaps are resolved by Boolean union; geometric connections are not certified walking circulation.
